value.behaviour: Unit tests for the range model: text edits, wrapping, list markers, runs, layout and creation.
rules: Build elements as { ...API.createElement({ type: "text", text }), originalText, textStyleRanges } with hand-written ids and seq; wrapped text is set by hand, e.g. text: "hello\nworld", originalText: "hello world". Build a scene with new Scene([element], { skipValidation: true }).
Canvas width in tests is the character count times 10.

value.behaviour: jsdom tests of the editor: colouring a selection, the layer behind the textarea, typing, and the element operations that must keep ranges.
rules: Setup per case: await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />), API.setElements([text]), API.setSelectedElements([text]), Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.ENTER), const editor = await getTextEditor(), editor.setSelectionRange(start, end).

Pick colours with UI.clickOnTestId(`color-top-pick-${color}`) using COLOR_PALETTE.red[DEFAULT_ELEMENT_STROKE_COLOR_INDEX] for stroke and #ffec99 for highlight; open the stroke popover by clicking the element matching [data-openpopup="elementStroke"] and pick with UI.clickOnTestId("color-red"). Clear buttons are test ids clear-text-color and clear-text-highlight.

Run actions with act(() => { h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value); }). actionChangeFontSize takes a number. actionChangeFontFamily takes { currentItemFontFamily: FONT_FAMILY.Cascadia, currentHoveredFontFamily: null }. A container resize is UI.resize(rectangle, "e", [-100, 0]).

An element copy: const { elements } = JSON.parse(serializeAsClipboardJSON({ elements: [text], files: null })), then act(() => h.app.addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary({ elements, files: null, position: "center" })). No toMatchSnapshot.
